question: Former Justice Commissioner Didier Reynders was questioned by Belgian police the week before last on suspicion of money laundering. According to Euronews, he is accused of laundering money, some of it through the Belgian National Lottery1. Since when has the Commission been aware of the Belgian police’s suspicions and investigations?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (7.3.2025) The Commission was informed of the allegations against former Commissioner Reynders and of the investigations carried out by the Belgian authorities on 4 December 2024 by the media.
